goal.insight: Encode a three-stage Sankey diagram: 9 primary energy sources (left) → 4 transformation processes (middle) → 5 end-use sectors (right), with flow band width proportional to energy in exajoules (EJ)
Visually highlight the waste/rejected heat flow using a distinct warm color so that its magnitude clearly stands out as larger than the combined total of all renewable energy source flows
Emphasize the dominant pathways from fossil fuels (oil, coal, natural gas) through thermal power generation and refining, showing how they constitute the bulk of total energy flow
Show the relatively thin flows from renewable sources (solar, wind, hydro, biomass, geothermal) compared to fossil fuel flows, making the scale disparity visually apparent
Display how energy distributes across the five end-use sectors (transport, industry, buildings, agriculture, other), with transport and industry receiving the largest shares
